# boxbox Provider

Machines of a tenant on a boxbox3 cluster (Proxmox VE), through boxbox3's HTTP API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials come from the environment:
#   BOXBOX_ENDPOINT              https://cluster.example.com
#   BOXBOX_API_TOKEN             <tenant>@pve!<tokenid>=<secret>   (PVE API token)
#   BOXBOX_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID      <id>.access                       (Cloudflare Access service token)
#   BOXBOX_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET  <secret>
provider "boxbox" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client ID of the Cloudflare Access service token that lets automation through the edge. Environment: `BOXBOX_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID`.
- `access_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Cloudflare Access service token. Environment: `BOXBOX_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) PVE API token of the tenant (or the owner): `<user>@pve!<tokenid>=<secret>`. Environment: `BOXBOX_API_TOKEN`.
- `endpoint` (String) Address of the cluster's web interface, like `https://cluster.example.com` (scheme and host only). Environment: `BOXBOX_ENDPOINT`.
